callout.$description: Icon width/height used by Callout, harvested from the prototype's calloutIcon() (17×17). Predates the Icons foundation size scale below (LDS-017) and stays a component-specific exception rather than being folded into it — 17px is Callout's own harvested value, not an instance of the inline icon's 16px box.

glyph-rail.$description: Glyph box in the dock rail and other collapsed-nav contexts, the lower end of the Icons foundation's Glyph scale (icoDocs "the dock rail at 22px, section tiles and empty states at 30–34px").

glyph-tile.$description: Glyph box for section tiles and empty states, the upper end of the Icons foundation's Glyph scale and the prototype glyph()'s own default size (icoDocs).

inline.$description: Inline icon box — fixed, not a range. The prototype's icon() hardcodes 16×16 with no size parameter, matching the Icons foundation's Inline icon scale ("sized ... to match 14px body text").

stroke-glyph.$description: Glyph stroke width on the 40 grid (Icons foundation Construction rule 2: "Stroke is 2.2 on the 40 grid and 2 on the 24 grid").

stroke-inline.$description: Inline icon stroke width on the 24 grid (Icons foundation Construction rule 2).
